hypothesis: Add one bounded task-agnostic confidence-penalty calibration pass after the Parent's unchanged five corpus-pretraining epochs, updating only the output projection on clean teacher-forced prefixes so overconfident next-token distributions retain more contextually available lexical support without changing the recurrent representation or downstream policy interface.
method_thesis: Train a task-agnostic autoregressive SMILES model only on the allowed unlabeled corpus, freeze a copy as the prior, and restart a trainable agent for each independent objective session. Generate the first proposals ancestrally, then use returned oracle scores to apply top-fraction prior-regularized likelihood updates to the agent. Whenever the recent reward trajectory shows sustained improvement, run Beam Enumeration on the current agent without calling the oracle: expand its most probable partial token trajectories, convert chemically interpretable partial strings into connected molecular substructures, and retain a small task-local pool of recurrent motifs. Fill subsequent evaluator-announced batches by sampling complete SMILES de novo from the agent and locally rejecting any valid novel sample that lacks every pooled motif; canonicalize and remove already evaluated or within-batch duplicates before submission. The enumerated objects are transient partial token trajectories, not whole candidate molecules, and neither they nor any corpus molecule are scored, ranked, retrieved, or submitted as a finite library. Thus oracle feedback changes both the policy and a dynamic structural gate on fresh generation, concentrating the 290 adaptive calls on chemistry expressed by successful policy updates while the only success criterion remains the mean of the five independent final Top-1 scores.

method_tags.acquisition_mechanism: membership in a task-local beam-derived motif pool before oracle submission, with no scoring of the transient internal samples
method_tags.learning_mechanism: offline corpus language-model training plus task-local top-fraction prior-regularized likelihood updates from current oracle feedback
method_tags.proposal_mechanism: dynamic top-probability beam expansion for motif extraction followed by motif-gated rejection sampling of complete de novo SMILES
method_tags.representation: tokenized SMILES plus RDKit-extracted connected substructures from partial token trajectories

activation_observables.measurement: Retain and digest the exact state produced by the unchanged fifth Parent epoch before calibration. On the identical fixed held-out token tensors under that pre-calibration state and the published post-calibration state, exclude PAD, BOS, and UNK from each next-token distribution, renormalize over EOS plus every lexical vocabulary token, and compute the normalized effective support exp(-sum(p * log(p))) / K at every non-padding target position, where K is the number of sampling-eligible outcomes. Report the token-count-weighted mean per preparation seed and pooled across all three seeds, the paired post-minus-pre change, and the fraction of held-out contexts whose effective support increases. Also record calibration context count, pre/post state digests, parameter-group digests, ordinary held-out NLL, and paired preparation-seeded ancestral completion and unique-valid rates as attribution and safety diagnostics. Activation requires a nonzero bounded calibration pass, bit-identical embedding and recurrent parameters, a changed output projection, and an increase in pooled held-out effective support from the exact Parent-equivalent snapshot.

applicability_conditions: The trained prior must have nonuniform conditional next-token distributions on a nonempty held-out set; an already uniform policy has no confidence concentration for this mechanism to relax.

Teacher-forced corpus contexts must overlap the prefixes encountered during ancestral generation closely enough that broader conditional support transfers to complete molecules rather than only raising entropy on irrelevant prefixes.

The fixed 0.05 normalized confidence penalty and one low-rate output-head pass are intended to preserve the Parent's learned recurrent syntax while relaxing only excessive output concentration. A larger penalty, repeated passes, or updates to the recurrent representation could increase malformed continuations and is outside this claim.

The mechanism can expose alternatives already represented by the serialized vocabulary and recurrent state, but cannot create tokens, molecular graphs, or reward-relevant chemistry absent from the unlabeled corpus support.

Node n-4e5816c945c0 does not settle this mechanism: that refuted intervention defined and reweighted a frequency tail whose preregistered types had zero held-out exposure, whereas this calibration uses no token-frequency classes or class weights and measures every held-out next-token context.

Node n-20155ff85181 shows that additional hard-target fitting can reduce valid-unique support even while NLL falls; the present claim is therefore conditional on confidence expansion occurring under the registered entropy term, not on an uncontrolled extra clean epoch being beneficial.

Preparation remains label-free and task agnostic, and transfer requires the unchanged two-file state/configuration artifact, vocabulary order, BOS/EOS/padding semantics, architecture, and downstream loading interface.

An increase in effective token support is only the proposed mediator. If ordinary held-out NLL, ancestral valid-unique support, or benchmark score deteriorates, the calibration may have activated without preserving useful molecular grammar or exposing reward-reachable chemistry.
research_intent.falsifier: The mechanism did not produce its claimed intermediate behavior if no eligible teacher-forced contexts receive the confidence-penalty update, if any embedding or recurrent parameter changes, if the published output projection is identical to the exact post-epoch-five Parent snapshot, or if pooled normalized held-out effective token support on the identical contexts fails to increase. If effective support increases but held-out NLL, ancestral valid-unique support, full-batch execution, or the three-seed macro score worsens, the mechanism activated but its proposed useful-support transfer did not hold.
research_intent.implementation_change: Preserve the Parent's seeded corpus reservoir and split, tokenizer and vocabulary, GRU architecture, optimizer trajectory and batch order for all five ordinary epochs, standard held-out and ancestral checks, artifact filenames and configuration interface, and every online generation, graph-equivalent replay, beam, motif, acquisition, canonicalization, duplicate-rejection, and oracle path. Immediately after the unchanged fifth epoch, copy and digest the exact Parent-equivalent state. Freeze the embedding and recurrent modules and run exactly one preparation-only pass over the same training prefixes with a fresh output-projection-only AdamW optimizer at 0.1 times the Parent pretraining learning rate. At each non-padding target position use the ordinary hard-target cross-entropy minus 0.05 times the Shannon entropy, normalized by log(K), of the distribution renormalized over EOS plus all non-special lexical outputs; PAD, BOS, and UNK receive no entropy reward. Keep the Parent gradient clip and a deterministic preparation-seed-derived batch order, then publish the calibrated state through the unchanged smiles_prior.pt and smiles_policy.json files while adding only calibration and paired pre/post audit metadata.

research_intent.observed_bottleneck: Parent n-a1feb7fbd3ae retains a five-epoch hard-target token-likelihood prior and reaches a three-seed macro mean of 0.4999210858091477, with its weakest task means still only 0.21139955631803173 on median_2 and 0.2611605684579006 on sitagliptin_mpo. The exact Parent-prior probe in n-1e6816bbc389 shows strong pooled held-out NLL of 0.677628237451252 and 768/768 ancestral completion, but only 656/768 completed draws are valid unique canonical molecules; because valid-canonical and unique-valid counts are identical, all 112 unusable completions are invalid rather than duplicate graphs. That node also shows no checkpoint-selection opportunity: the terminal state has the best audited valid-unique support on every preparation seed. Evidence from the same clean GRU-prior family in n-20155ff85181 sharpens the diagnosis: three more hard-target epochs lower training NLL by 0.024093488852183025 yet reduce preparation valid-unique support from 645/768 to 609/768 and change macro score by -0.00274054926385936. The limiting behavior addressed here is therefore confidence concentration under an exclusively hard-target objective with no pressure to retain plausible alternative next tokens, not premature stopping, selection of the wrong existing checkpoint, graph replay, beam triggering, or motif gating.

applicability_conditions: For this fixed five-epoch GRU prior, three seeded unlabeled-corpus splits, serialized vocabularies with 71, 73, and 75 sampling-eligible outcomes, and the registered one-pass 0.05 confidence penalty, output-only calibration does not support the claimed increase in held-out effective token support.

The evidence does support that the bounded intervention can update only the output projection while preserving bit-identical embedding and recurrent parameters and improving ordinary held-out NLL on all three preparation seeds.
Transfer to ancestral usable support is not stable: completion decreased by one of 768 pooled samples, pooled unique-valid support was unchanged, and seed-level unique-valid changes had mixed signs.

The positive paired Hard-Five scores remain an empirical downstream result of this implementation, but they do not validate the proposed support-expansion mediator and should not be generalized beyond the fixed corpus, vocabulary, architecture, task suite, and evaluation profile.

activation_observables.name: prior_token_support_coverage

applicability_conditions: The trained prior must have nonuniform conditional next-token distributions on a nonempty held-out set; an already uniform policy has no confidence concentration for this mechanism to relax.

Teacher-forced corpus contexts must overlap the prefixes encountered during ancestral generation closely enough that broader conditional support transfers to complete molecules rather than only raising entropy on irrelevant prefixes.

The fixed 0.05 normalized confidence penalty and one low-rate output-head pass are intended to preserve the Parent's learned recurrent syntax while relaxing only excessive output concentration. A larger penalty, repeated passes, or updates to the recurrent representation could increase malformed continuations and is outside this claim.

The mechanism can expose alternatives already represented by the serialized vocabulary and recurrent state, but cannot create tokens, molecular graphs, or reward-relevant chemistry absent from the unlabeled corpus support.

Node n-4e5816c945c0 does not settle this mechanism: that refuted intervention defined and reweighted a frequency tail whose preregistered types had zero held-out exposure, whereas this calibration uses no token-frequency classes or class weights and measures every held-out next-token context.

Node n-20155ff85181 shows that additional hard-target fitting can reduce valid-unique support even while NLL falls; the present claim is therefore conditional on confidence expansion occurring under the registered entropy term, not on an uncontrolled extra clean epoch being beneficial.

Preparation remains label-free and task agnostic, and transfer requires the unchanged two-file state/configuration artifact, vocabulary order, BOS/EOS/padding semantics, architecture, and downstream loading interface.

An increase in effective token support is only the proposed mediator. If ordinary held-out NLL, ancestral valid-unique support, or benchmark score deteriorates, the calibration may have activated without preserving useful molecular grammar or exposing reward-reachable chemistry.
